title: Vanilla Foods
description: A texture pack that allows you to change the name of a item and it will change the texture
body:
A texture pack that allows you to change the name of a item to a texture list of items

Fried egg,
schnitzel,
Beef jerky,
Honey Cookie,
green apple,
candy apple,
strawbarry,
banana,
cook book,
**All images are in image gallery**
